name: TC-AN-QB-006 — 批量填写：非法JSON格式 [P1]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea, .ant-input'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, '这不是JSON{broken'); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认')); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const modalStillOpen = !!modal && modal.offsetParent !== null; const errors = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-alert-error'); const errorTexts = Array.from(errors).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); return { modalStillOpen, errorTexts, hasError: errorTexts.length > 0 || modalStillOpen }; })()
steps.description: 验证弹窗保持打开且有错误提示

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」\n2. 粘贴非法内容: '这不是JSON{broken'\n3. 点击确认导入
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 弹窗保持打开，不关闭\n2. 展示错误提示（JSON格式错误/必须是数组等）\n3. 用户可修正后重试
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
